coaching.headline: Won on objectives: two Fangtooths, two Mini Primes and Genesis Core went allied while enemy objective damage stalled at 46.

flags.text: Lt. Belica: zero fucking deaths, ten kills across all five enemies, mid outer and inner razed.
Khaimera drew first blood on Yurei in the enemy jungle, and 30832 objective damage topped all ten players.
Grux's 25497 hero damage led the game; a mid rotation kill on Gideon preceded the enemy mid outer.
Shit stretch around the second Fangtooth: Skylar, Khaimera and Argus died, then the allied mid outer fell.

focus.title: Leave the pit, hit a tower
focus.action: Once a Fangtooth is secured, Khaimera and Argus leave the pit together at once, and the team walks to the nearest standing enemy tower rather than trading at the pit.

13.call: Kills spread over mid, offlane, the enemy jungle and the duo lane went 5-0; Lt. Belica took the enemy mid outer and Argus razed the duo outer. Map-wide pressure is the template.

19.7.call: Mini Prime went allied, then Grux killed Yurei in the enemy jungle and Lt. Belica killed Sevarog on the offlane, a fight won 2-0. Secure each Mini Prime before taking the next fight.

21.4.call: Lt. Belica killed Yurei on mid, the enemy offlane inner fell, Lt. Belica razed the mid inner and Grux killed Sevarog in the enemy base. Two inner towers fell inside one 2-0 window; hit towers during won fights like that again.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Hero damage ran 986 per minute against a 591 norm, and 5919 objective damage trailed only Khaimera. That output with zero deaths is the mid standard.
Four rotation kills after the enemy mid outer fell: Sevarog twice on the offlane, then Sparrow and Sevarog on the duo lane. With mid open, keep joining the nearest fight.
33331211-2671-4dee-8b8f-abaac64114eb: Hero damage ran 1109 per minute on a 713 norm; the lone death came to Yurei on the offlane. Before a long offlane trade, check where Yurei was last seen.
Zero objective damage while the enemy offlane outer and inner fell. With Sevarog dead and allied minions at the tower, hit the structure before the next fight.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: CS ran 9.4 per minute against a 7.1 norm alongside the objective work. Keep clearing between spawns, and call each Fangtooth and Mini Prime to the team before starting.
Killed Gideon on mid in the enemy half, and Gideon's four kills all landed on Argus and Skylar. When Gideon shows near the duo lane, path there first.
e9ff6ee7-7261-4485-87b9-57fced6d5f66: Three kills on Sparrow, the enemy duo outer razed, 3 wards cleared, the most of all ten. Against Steel's 14 wards, sweep before objectives if sentry is equipped.
All three deaths went to Gideon: in the enemy jungle, at the Fangtooth pit and on the duo lane. While Gideon is unseen, ward ahead before stepping up.
5c810e0f-8de4-4437-9de6-05be35fe2e05: Hero damage ran 798 per minute on a 1258 norm, CS 6.7 on 7.9, with two items finished. When the duo lane is quiet, take every wave before joining plays.
Four deaths, the allied high, all in the enemy half: two to Sparrow, then Sevarog and Gideon. Cross into the enemy half only once Sparrow is dead or seen elsewhere.

matchup: Duo was Argus and Skylar against Sparrow and Steel; enemy duo deaths before minute ten ran three to zero.
Steel placed 14 wards to the 9 from Argus; the support vision count went to the enemy.
build: Combustion, Caustica and Wraith Leggings make a mage damage build; Timewarp, Tainted Scepter and Dynamo, the winning core, are all missing.
Caustica ignores a share of magical armor and adds ability damage against heroes above half health with bonus magical armor.
Wraith Leggings, finished last, adds ability damage on low-health heroes; earlier fights ran without Wraith Leggings.
eternal: Vesh turns a share of ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage to the major.
Argus support field: Vesh ties Lotus at the top, and Lich plus Mind Rot leads the Vesh pairs. Sound keep.
augment: Mana Catalyst restores mana from damage dealt to heroes, with basic attacks restoring more.
Arcane Engine leans first in the Argus support field; Mana Catalyst ranks last of three.
crest: Tranquility's active heals Argus and nearby heroes and grants brief damage mitigation; the Visionary passive raises the ward cap.
Leafsong and Tranquility are a toss-up atop the Argus support crests. Sound keep.
improvement: Arcane Engine for Mana Catalyst is the field lean: stacking movement speed from ability hits on heroes instead of mana refunds.
Lt. Belica already built Tainted Scepter against Yurei's 13304 healing; Argus adds Tainted Scepter only when Lt. Belica skips anti-heal.

matchup: Offlane against Sevarog: Grux killed Sevarog twice, and Sevarog's 33488 mitigated damage was the most of all ten.
Sevarog's Subjugate chains enemies to a zone and stuns any chained hero leaving; Phantom Rush fears.
build: Sky Splitter is the one winning-core item built; Basilisk and Salvation are missing.
Sky Splitter deals a share of the target's current health on each basic-attack hit.
Tainted Rounds, finished last, cuts the target's healing briefly after each basic-attack hit; earlier fights ran without Tainted Rounds.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack for more damage dealt to, and less taken from, that hero.
Knell leans ahead of Thraex in the Grux offlane field; Savage Strikes with Ferocity is the best Thraex pair.
augment: Lust For Blood heals for a share of damage dealt to enemies afflicted with max Bloodlust stacks.
Red Mist and Chieftain's Blink are a toss-up atop the Grux offlane augments; Lust For Blood, the most played, ranks third.
crest: Iceskorn Talons lays an ice sheet: allies on the sheet gain physical power and movement speed, enemies on the sheet are slowed.
Gravitum, Eviscerator and Saphir's Mantle are a toss-up atop the Grux offlane crests; Iceskorn Talons, the most played, ranks fourth.
improvement: Red Mist for Lust For Blood is the toss-up lead: attack speed per nearby Bloodlust-afflicted enemy instead of the healing.
Gravitum shares the Champion Crest path with Iceskorn Talons: a long-range grounding shot instead of the ice sheet.

matchup: Mid against Gideon: Lt. Belica killed Gideon once, and Gideon never killed Lt. Belica.
Gideon's Black Hole pulls nearby enemies, and the Cosmic Power passive tethers a target, rooting after a delay.
build: Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings, the full winning core, are all built.
Noxia marks heroes hit by ability damage; hitting the marked hero with a separate ability adds max-health damage.
Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage, against Sevarog's 5007 healing; Noxia, finished last, missed earlier fights.
eternal: Lich adds magical lifesteal that grows with level, the sustain half of this Vesh setup.
Lotus leans first in the Lt. Belica mid field; Vesh, the most played, ranks last of the ranked Eternals.
The Tenth Seal with Millennia is the best Vesh pair; Lich with Mind Rot trails.
augment: Devastating Bombs makes Void Bomb hit isolated targets harder.
Combat Veteran is clearly the best Lt. Belica mid augment; Devastating Bombs, the most played, ranks third.
crest: Epoch's active places Lt. Belica in stasis briefly.
Typhoon and Epoch are a toss-up atop the Lt. Belica mid crests. Sound keep.
improvement: Combat Veteran for Devastating Bombs is the clear field swap: movement speed and passive experience over bonus Void Bomb damage.
Lotus over Vesh is the field lean, trading ability damage over time for random stats gained over time and on takedowns.

matchup: Duo against Sparrow and Steel: Skylar killed Steel twice and Sparrow once; Sparrow killed Skylar twice.
Sparrow's Relentless passive adds max-health damage per stack on hits; Heightened Senses enters stealth.
build: Vanquisher matches the winning core; Plasma Blade and Imperator, the critical-strike pair, were both missing.
Vanquisher's Annihilate executes a hero dropped under a sliver of health.
Resolution adds mana-scaled on-hit damage, plus physical power once the max mana stacks fill.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health damage on every third consecutive basic attack on one hero; Serration adds missing-health damage.
Thraex, Xyris and Weald are a toss-up atop the Skylar carry field; Vermis trails every Eternal with enough games.
augment: Assault MK-II makes Air Assault hover longer and fire an extra missile with each attack.
Assault MK-II leans first in the Skylar carry augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Liberator's active cleanses all debuffs and grants a short shield.
Eviscerator leans first in the Skylar carry crests; Liberator, the most played, ranks third behind Pacifier.
improvement: Thraex over Vermis is the toss-up lead: a mark adding damage dealt to, and cutting damage taken from, the last hero hit.
Eviscerator for Liberator stays on the Sharpshooter Crest path, swapping the cleanse and shield for attack speed, omnivamp and on-hit damage.

matchup: Jungle against Yurei: Yurei finished 1/6/2 with 8347 gold to Khaimera's 11107.
Steel, the lone killer of Khaimera, stuns with Shield Bash, Bull Rush and Shield Slam.
Yurei's Severance resets on Soul-Ripped targets, and Soulstorm pulls enemies in at the end.
build: Overlord matches the winning core; Draconum and Rapture never came, with Sky Splitter taking the second slot.
Overlord cleaves around the basic-attack target and permanently adds health from kills.
Sky Splitter's current-health damage peaks on full-health targets, fitting Sevarog and Steel, the top two mitigators.
eternal: Lotus grants random stats every two minutes and on takedowns; Early Bloom adds an extra level at level twelve.
Lotus leans first in the Khaimera jungle field; Masterpiece with Prima Donna is the best Lotus pair.
Early Bloom with Immaculate trails the other three Lotus pairs with enough games.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion is clearly the best Khaimera jungle augment. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage and heals on hero hits.
Eviscerator is clearly the best Khaimera jungle crest; Judgement ranks fifth.
improvement: Eviscerator for Judgement is the clear crest swap, from Champion Crest to Sharpshooter Crest: attack speed and omnivamp over the area heal.
Masterpiece with Prima Donna over Early Bloom with Immaculate: kill-stacking damage and speed plus more hero damage, but more damage taken.

threats: Dive threat on our backline: Yurei. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

ourKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
ourKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
ourKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
ourKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
ourKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
ourKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
ourKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
ourKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Anima Burst / Whispering Echoes apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul-Ripped targets → Soulstorm pulls them in
enemyKits.winCondition: chain Severance resets to stick to a target and burst in melee
enemyKits.passive: casting grants ranged empowered basics + attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
enemyKits.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip resets — peel/disengage breaks it; punish when Severance is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
enemyKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
enemyKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

lines: Black Hole at rank 2: 120s base, about 101.7s by the end (15% shorter) from 18 ability haste: Azure Core 10, Soulbearer 8.
Gideon dealt 14,509 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +285 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11; against Argus (level 13: about 42 magical armor, 22 after penetration; took 6,186 magical damage from heroes, 54% of all hero damage they took) and Skylar (level 13: about 42 magical armor, 22 after penetration; took 4,772 magical damage from heroes, 47% of all hero damage they took) that is about 16% and 16% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 16.2% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Millennia (Eternal minor): Every 60s, increase your Ultimate Ability Damage by 0.75%.
Event Horizon (augment): Cosmic Rift deals an additional (+4% Target's Max Health) damage to Enemies in the center.

Sustain: Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; Lich: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.; 1,593 healing recorded.
Lesson: Gideon's penetration cut through: Argus took about 16% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 13 their armor was about 42, about 22 after 20 flat penetration).

(game text: Cosmic Rift deals an additional (+4% Target's Max Health) damage to Enemies in the center.) (changes Cosmic Rift, 7.6s cooldown with their haste) Field: 47.6% in 3972 games, 32% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.3%.

Loadout Eternal Vesh: Every ability hit leaves a short burn. Void Breach, Cosmic Rift and Black Hole all add extra damage after they land. (game text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.) [7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 16.2% by the end (23 min)] Field: 49% in 8634 games, 70% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.3%.

Loadout minor Lich: Your magic damage heals you, growing as you level. Black Hole and Cosmic Rift hitting several enemies make it heal a lot in team fights. (game text: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.) Field: 50.3% in 1943 games, 23% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.3%.

Loadout minor Millennia: Your ultimate's damage slowly grows over the game. A small late-game boost to Black Hole; nothing else changes. (game text: Every 60s, increase your Ultimate Ability Damage by 0.75%.) Field: 49.7% in 1630 games, 19% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.3%.

Loadout crest Soulbearer: A shield plus magic healing and movement speed. Pop it before a fight to survive the dive and heal off your Cosmic Rift and Black Hole damage. (game text: Anima:  Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.) Field: 51.3% in 8641 games, 70% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.3%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Vesh. Gideon has 3 damaging abilities (Void Breach, Cosmic Rift, Black Hole hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 18 ability haste brought them back 15% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Soulbearer, Event Horizon. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Wraith Leggings. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Soulbearer, Lich.

The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Lich + Millennia) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; healing off the damage), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 0 of the 2 players Gideon killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Grux, Lt. Belica. We killed Gideon 4 times.

Copy it? Vesh: 49% in 8,634 Gideon midlane games, level with the hero's 48.3%; this 3-item core: 52.5% in 2,815 games, level with the 52.4% of that hero-role's cores. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

fedBy: Tainted Scepter (Malice): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice.• Stacks up to 15 times.• Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly.• Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 23 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of Lt. Belica mid players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Neural Disruptor at rank 2: 105s base, about 76.1s by the end (28% shorter) from 38 ability haste: Tainted Scepter 10, Noxia 20, Epoch 8.
14 takedowns (10 kills, 4 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Lt. Belica dealt 22,682 hero damage, 22% of their team's, with +380 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11; against Yurei (level 12: about 50 magical armor, 30 after penetration; took 7,140 magical damage from heroes, 48% of all hero damage they took) and Sevarog (level 13: about 51 magical armor, 31 after penetration; took 5,422 magical damage from heroes, 18% of all hero damage they took) that is about 15% and 15% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Noxia (item): Deal 6% of Target's Maximum Health as bonus Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 16.2% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
Mind Rot (Eternal minor): The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.
Devastating Bombs (augment): Void Bomb deals 15% more damage to Isolated Targets.
Sustain: Lich: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.; 1,467 healing recorded.
Toughness: +200 health; took 10,411 damage, mitigated 5,800, died 0 times.

Lesson: Lt. Belica's penetration cut through: Yurei took about 15% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 12 their armor was about 50, about 30 after 20 flat penetration).

Loadout augment Devastating Bombs: Void Bomb hits harder on enemies standing alone. Aim bombs at a solo laner or someone separated from their team. (game text: Void Bomb deals 15% more damage to Isolated Targets.) (changes Void Bomb, 5.1s cooldown with their haste) Field: 50.4% in 3667 games, 40% of picks, below the hero-role's 51.4%.

Loadout Eternal Vesh: Ability damage to heroes also adds a short burn. Void Bomb, Seismic Assault and the drone zaps all keep ticking after they land. (game text: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.) [7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 16.2% by the end (23 min)] Field: 49.5% in 4154 games, 45% of picks, below the hero-role's 51.4%.

Loadout minor Lich: Magical lifesteal that grows with level. Belica's abilities all deal magic damage, so every bomb and wave heals her. (game text: Gain 4%/7%/10%/14% Magical Lifesteal at Levels 1/6/11/16.) Field: 50.6% in 832 games, 20% of picks, level the hero-role's 51.4%.

Loadout minor Mind Rot: The Vesh burn also deals damage based on the target's current health. Strongest when opening on healthy enemies with Void Bomb. (game text: The major also deals 2% of the target's current health as bonus damage.) Field: 49.2% in 3055 games, 74% of picks, below the hero-role's 51.4%.

Loadout crest Epoch: Freeze yourself in stasis for 2.5s. Use it after you get dived, letting your drone and allies punish the attackers. (game text: Stasis Device:  Enter Stasis for 2.5s.) Field: 51.9% in 4838 games, 52% of picks, level the hero-role's 51.4%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Noxia, Vesh, Mind Rot. Lt. Belica has 4 damaging abilities (Void Bomb, Seismic Assault, Void Drone hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 38 ability haste brought them back 28% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Damage that scales with the target's health): 2 effects on one trigger: Noxia, Mind Rot. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on the other side fed them.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Lich + Mind Rot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; damage that scales with the target's health), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Lt. Belica killed built magical armor (Steel). Health items on Sevarog, Steel raised the %-health damage they took. We killed Lt. Belica 0 times.

Copy it? Vesh (Lich + Mind Rot): 49.7% in 557 Lt. Belica midlane games, below the hero's 51.4%; this 3-item core: 58.9% in 141 games, above the 53.1% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.

card.lesson: Neural Disruptor came back about every 76s instead of 105s by the end (28% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
